content.comment_body: Hello! I have a [article_no] [product_name] module and a connection cable [article_no]. I'm trying to connect it to my PC using this cable, but I can't figure out how to switch between 'PC/Card' mode. The menu on my device shows: Program, Card, Setup, Start. Where can I change to PC <-> Cable connection? In the 'Card...' menu, it seems to only allow card connection and I can't find PC <-> Cable. Could something be wrong with my device? Thanks for any assistance.

Dear [user_name], There's no issue with the device. The [product_name] [article_no] will automatically enter transfer mode. According to the manual: When you start an upload or download in STOP mode, the display will automatically show: PC <-> [product_name]. This happens when you select Transfer in [product_name] software, provided the PC is connected to the device. Best regards, [user_name]

You need to establish the connection from your computer, not directly on the device. In [product_name] software, go to 'Tools' -> 'Establish connection with modem' (apologies, my software interface is in Spanish). This starts a wizard for configuring the PC-to-device connection where you can choose the communication port or IP address, whether you are connecting via USB or network.

Hello [user_name], Hope my suggestions help: First, go to your PC's network properties, right-click on the connection used between the PC and the [product_name], and select properties. Change the IP address so only the last digits differ from your device's IP, for example: Device: 192.168.1.10 PC: 192.168.1.11 Next, in the options of [product_name] software, configure the IP addresses accordingly. Check out this guide: [url], especially steps 1 through 13. In Step 6, there is a 'detect' button that lets you test whether your PC-device connection works. If you have further questions, I'm happy to assist. Greetings,

analysis.insight_summary: Users are unclear about how to set up and change the communication mode between a [product_name] module and a PC using [product_name] software. The device's interface doesn't make the PC connection mode obvious, leading to confusion. Community responses clarify that transfer mode activates automatically and that most configuration is managed from the PC software, but the procedure is not straightforward for new users.
analysis.user_expectations: Users expect a simple and direct way on the device to switch to PC connection mode, preferably through an accessible menu option, making setup clear and easy.
